name: task-5
_ambiguities: Config panel hidden in preview is NOT asserted. 'Hidden' could mean display:none or removal, and the replay ops cannot assert a negative visibility without pinning one of those.
'Not editable' is asserted as no element with contenteditable="true" in the preview page. A contenteditable="false" or no attribute both pass.
The order of preview questions relative to design is not asserted (titles are random).
The preview page's survey title is not asserted; the task does not give its text or position.
Preview is checked only through the Preview button flow, as the task requires; loading preview.html directly with stored data is not tested.
The form action check uses the initial-state value 'submit' from the context section.
